items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby. Missed Friday practice after limited Thursday.
items.implication: GTD; if OUT, backup committee or Washington/Hemby workload spike
items.opportunity: If out, clear path for elevated/backup RBs carries and snaps
items.conflict: Coach says 'do his best to go'

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details worked out (no deal until after games). Houston among teams with interest.
items.why: Trade finalizing; team comfortable enough to sit him
items.implication: Zero Week 5 production; destination TBD post-games impacts ROS
items.opportunity: Opens targets/routes for remaining ARI pass-catchers

items.implication: PHI backfield to backups/handcuffs; zero production
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining PHI RBs

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT; Huntley expected to start.
items.why: ETR board and reports confirm ankle
items.implication: BAL pass game/QB scoring tanks; RBs/TEs shift
items.opportunity: Likely/Andrews volume in checkdown-heavy script; Flowers Q status key

items.text: Steelers officially placed Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot); minimum 4 games.
items.implication: PIT WR depth chart shuffle ROS for at least a month
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Steelers WRs

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor in Michael Wilson's production; inactive/trade is Kia Kendrick Bourne season.
items.why: Low volume/impact already; Wilson already leading
items.implication: Minimal fantasy hit from MHJ absence; Wilson/Bourne/McBride absorb
items.opportunity: Wilson target share and red-zone already strong; further consolidation

items.implication: NYJ RB volume to backups; Allen becomes RB2/flex
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for remaining Jets RBs

items.implication: WAS WR targets consolidate to McLaurin (Q) and others
items.opportunity: McLaurin/Deebo/others route and target bump if McLaurin plays

items.implication: LAC WR targets to McConkey (Q) and others

items.text: Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert all IN (cleared/off report).
items.why: ETR IN list after prior uncertainty
items.implication: Full or near-full roles expected; reverse prior beneficiary speculation

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ankle maintenance, limited practice but 'full-go'); ETR projects him 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with much bigger/better role expected after Week 4 usage criticism.
items.why: Off report; media/fan pressure on prior low usage may expand role; gut says much better
items.implication: RB2/flex upside vs DET if workload jumps; still some maintenance downside risk
items.conflict: Ankle maintenance and long-season fatigue risk remain

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term (knee becoming issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB, coaching boomer tendencies) despite no Week 5 designation and prior frustration over targets.
items.why: Stacked injury + QB + scheme risks even if playing now
items.implication: Playable short-term but elevated ROS volatility; monitor closely
items.conflict: No current injury designation; good play this week per Levitan

items.text: Loves Nico Collins WR8 @TEN (volume/RZ/matchup), Michael Wilson WR10 vs DET, Christian Watson WR15 vs CHI, Isaiah Likely TE5 @WSH, Chase Brown RB5 @MIA (workload + CIN injuries).
items.why: Target/RZ volume + soft matchups; Brown boosted by CIN WR injuries
items.implication: Strong start recommendations; Wilson further boosted by MHJ inactive
items.opportunity: High target/route shares in favorable spots

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison WR41 @NO (injury/usage/matchup), Mark Andrews TE17 @ATL, Cam Skattebo RB20 @WSH, Tony Pollard RB28 vs HOU, Jalen Hurts QB15 vs JAX (London, line/rough stretch).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin/inefficient roles, usage concerns, game environment
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats this week
